{{dablink|For other uses of the word "eye," see [[Eye]].}}
'''''Sei'taer''''' is an [[Old Tongue]] word meaning "straight eyes" or "level eyes."

==Use==
Honor is supremely important to the [[Seanchan]]. To them, a word of honor, once given, is final and considered absolute. For the Seanchan, honor and status are directly linked with looking someone in the eyes. Therefore, the Old Tongue word ''sei'taer'', is presumably given to those of [[The Blood]]. Among the Seanchan, to say that someone "has ''sei'taer''" or "is ''sei'taer''" means they have "face," or honor. "Face" can be lowered or earned. It can also be lost.
